h1: Custom Direct to Film Pants & Shorts
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Pants & Shorts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film pants and shorts for your team. Vibrant, durable prints. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Direct to film printing on pants and shorts gives you the ability to reproduce detailed logos, gradients, and small text with exceptional color vibrancy and durability. Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF transfers adhere well to polyester blends commonly used in athletic and workwear bottoms. This method is ideal for customizing uniform pants, team shorts, or promotional apparel where you need a soft hand feel and wash-resistant finish. Perfect for bulk orders with multiple design colors.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film pants and shorts with vibrant full-color logo prints for team uniforms or promotional use.
